Note: SW 0.1.8 - DIAGNOSTIC RELEASE, NOT a series standard. One constant changed against 0.1.7: SETTLE_LONG_CYCLES 5000 -> 20000, so Options DIP 6 = ON now gives ~400 us of dead time between the column change and the rows going live instead of ~110 us. Reason: 0.1.7 in the field left 595 group 6 (ULN2003A A20, FA-Control lamps 20..23) glowing and DIP 6 made no difference - and per the base-charge estimate in docs/Lamp_Refresh_Analysis.md 3.3 that is NOT yet an acquittal for the column driver, because turn-off runs through 8.2 K at ~85 uA against ~0.2 A of base drive and can therefore take hundreds of microseconds. 400 us decides it: if the glow changes, it was the column turn-off time and the smallest value that still works becomes the series standard
column9: if nothing changes, the column is settled and the remaining cause is the ULN residual current, which no software can address (field fix: 2.2 kOhm across the socket). The price is deliberate and must be said out loud to the tester: DIP 6 = ON costs three quarters of the brightness (duty 5.0 percent instead of 22.1), so it is a measurement setting, not a setting to play on. Everything else is untouched - series value stays SETTLE_CYCLES 2500 (~60 us, duty 22.1 percent), DIP 5 = ON stays the original timing (24.5 percent), and the phase stays 25600 clk = 512 us in all three positions because the dwell absorbs the difference (4597 clk = 92 us of dwell are left at 20000, and 24597 is the hard ceiling before dwell_lim would go negative). The +1 register against 0.1.7 is the dwell counter growing one bit: its range is 0..DWELL+SETTLE+SETTLE_LONG, which went from 29597 to 44597 and therefore from 15 to 16 bits. Both variants must show that +1 and they do. Comb pcb unchanged, dev_open +17, so the gap between the variants is 5 now (12 at 0.1.7, 4 at 0.1.6) - the version nibble x7 -> x8 folding differently per variant, as at every bump. Memory UNCHANGED at 202752, the acceptance criterion. Slack 3.431 -> 3.384, i.e. unchanged in practice despite the wider counter, and the tight domain is cpu_clk as always. Still 85 of 89 pins. Warnings unchanged. Earlier history for reference: 0.1.7 introduced the three dead-time steps and Options DIP 6 (+1 register for long_mode) and was field tested on an Airborne Avenger and a Middle Earth - both 0.1.6 fixes confirmed, group 6 open, see docs/Lamp_Preglow_Experiment.md 6

Built and kept in lockstep with the lead variant - there is no HAS_ flag, lamp_matrix is in files_common.tcl and both boards get the 400 us step.
